papers.title: Compared to What? Calibrating Machine-Unlearning Diagnostics with Present, Absent and Suppressed Anchors
papers.note: Tests which unlearning diagnostics can tell removal from suppression, using cases where the answer is known.

papers.title: Grokking as a Subspace Search: Computing the Destination Before Training
papers.note: Shows the grokking destination can be computed before training on group tasks.

papers.title: Which Loopholes Get Found? Predicting Reward Hacking of LLM Judges Before RL Training
papers.note: Predicts which LLM judge loophole a GRPO policy will exploit first, before training.

papers.title: Returning to the Neuron Basis for Interpretability
papers.note: Anthropic posts arguing that raw neurons support useful safety probes and audits without training an SAE. Part 2 covers applications.

papers.title: AI R&D-relevant model capabilities are improving rapidly and are getting harder to measure
papers.note: METR's new time-horizon task suite and its limits, including LLM judges rating similar models too highly.

papers.title: cmHC: Balancing Stream Mixing in Hyper-Connections via Geometric Contraction
papers.note: Studies how much residual streams should mix in hyper-connections, with bounds on too little and too much mixing.

papers.title: Embo-Harness: Towards Understanding Frontier-Model-as-Policy Harness
papers.note: Tests prompting, planning, action and tool-use choices when a frontier model acts directly as a robot policy.

papers.title: Posterior Matching Distillation
papers.note: A diffusion distillation method that covers the teacher's modes instead of collapsing to the dominant ones.

papers.title: Clover-35B-A3B-Preview Technical Report
papers.note: A mixture-of-experts diffusion language model with strong reported agent scores and fast single-GPU generation.

papers.title: MemOnce: A Scalable Memory Architecture for Large Language Models
papers.note: Caches a few compact memory states and decodes them back into KV caches, for long interactions with less GPU memory.
